title: 'Int'l system broken': Rubio's msg amid UNGA, says US interests above world order
content: At the UN General Assembly, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio raised alarm over the deteriorating international system, stating that it has outlived its usefulness in addressing significant geopolitical disputes. He observed a unanimous perspective among world leaders regarding its inadequacy, leading to a focus on national interests. Nevertheless, Rubio acknowledged the system's value and stressed the urgency for reform to revitalize global governance and collaboration.

title: India's proposal under consideration for safe Black Sea shipping, Zelenskyy says
content: India, Egypt, and Turkey are exploring maritime truce options for safe navigation in the Black Sea. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy indicated readiness to support a truce if Russia responds positively. India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar is actively engaging with both Ukraine and Russia to mediate the conflict. Disruptions in shipping have impacted grain supplies globally, raising concerns among multiple countries.

title: DoorDash agrees to $131.5m after payment errors affected 200,000-plus NYC workers
content: DoorDash will pay $131.5 million to settle a probe regarding its payment practices for delivery workers. The settlement will directly benefit over 260,000 Dashers, addressing both missing and late payments. An additional dispute over calculation methods for on-call pay times has also been resolved in this agreement. DoorDash has acknowledged the issues caused by technical errors and improved its payment processes.

title: Africa’s richest man picks Indian PSU for $450 million refinery contract in Kenya
content: Aliko Dangote has hired Engineers India Ltd to oversee his $16 billion refinery construction in Kenya. The refinery in Lamu will have a capacity of 700,000 barrels per day when completed. Dangote plans to strengthen regional energy security by reducing reliance on imports through this project. Work is scheduled to begin by the end of September as part of a larger expansion plan.

title: Not an apartment, but an entire tower: Angel One founder buys it for Rs 711 crore
content: Dinesh Thakkar, founder and CMD of financial services and stockbroking company Angel One, will acquire an entire luxury residential tower in Mumbai's Juhu area from Embassy Developments for more than Rs 711 crore.

title: 'Like we did in Asia Cup': Pakistan to put India 'under pressure' in Asian Games
content: Since Hesson took charge in May last year, Pakistan have lost to India three times in the 2025 Asia Cup and once at this year's Twenty20 World Cup.

title: One Indian killed after ship attacked off Oman coast; MEA condemns incident
content: In a tragic incident off the coast of Oman, the MV Cape Dao was attacked while en route to India, resulting in the death of one Indian seafarer. Nineteen others were successfully rescued, and the Indian Ministry of External Affairs expressed its condolences. The embassy in Oman is actively coordinating the repatriation of the crew, reiterating India's commitment to ensuring safe navigation in international waters.

title: Student builds $100 particle detector now used in major physics experiments
content: CosmicWatch is a compact and affordable particle detector that can be used for research and education purposes. Developed by physicist Spencer Axani, it costs about $100 and can be assembled easily. The portable device detects muons, allowing students to investigate cosmic-ray interactions and environmental changes. Researchers have successfully utilized it in high-altitude experiments and various scientific studies.

title: Salesforce CEO blames Microsoft for not investing in OpenAI
content: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says Microsoft's stake in OpenAI stopped his company from investing in the ChatGPT maker. Speaking on Alex Heath's Sources podcast, Benioff said Sam Altman turned him down, pushing Salesforce towards rival Anthropic. That early 2023 bet is reportedly worth about $5 billion, and Benioff believes it could earn Salesforce tens of billions as Claude maker Anthropic prepares for a public listing.

title: IIT-B suicide case: New CCTV footage shows Sahil before he left exam hall
content: CCTV footage reveals Sahil Wakode's actions before his death during an exam at IIT-Bombay. His family claims he faced caste-based harassment and institutional pressure leading to suicide. Police have registered a case of abetment against multiple individuals linked to the incident. Protests erupted on campus, prompting calls for systemic reforms and better support for students. The institute acknowledged discussions regarding the issue while maintaining protocol adherence by its staff.

title: Donald Trump says Canada has too many immigrants, but the math doesn’t add up
content: Canada has recently admitted a record number of permanent residents, primarily focusing on economic immigration programs. In contrast, the US processes significantly more green cards through family-based categories than Canada does. India's immigrants play critical roles in both countries, particularly in skilled job sectors. Trump's comments regarding immigration have drawn criticism for being racially charged and factually inaccurate.

title: Who is Kate Martin? Meet Chicago Sky guard, parents, ex-girlfriend and career
content: Kate Martin has joined the Chicago Sky on a developmental contract after playing for multiple teams. She was previously selected by the Las Vegas Aces and also played for the Golden State Valkyries and Los Angeles Sparks. Martin made her debut with the Sky against the Toronto Tempo, scoring five points. Her aunt, Iowa head coach Jan Jensen, has been a strong supporter throughout her career.

title: Julio Rodriguez’s ‘DJ Pleno’ alter ego: Mariners star’s passion for DJing
content: Outside of baseball, Seattle Mariners star Julio Rodriguez is finding a different side of himself through his emerging DJ identity, 'DJ Pleno'; and what started as a personal hobby in the aftermath of the 2025 season has grown into a true passion, and Rodriguez has been performing live at T-Mobile Park. The MLB star’s increasing love of house music is providing him with a creative outlet off the diamond.

title: EC 'dissent' row: Oppn seeks fresh polls, CEC's arrest; BJP lauds 'pure democracy'
content: Opposition parties in India are demanding action against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar amid allegations of electoral fraud. Reports indicate that Election Commissioners have raised objections about the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Leaders from various parties are calling for Kumar's resignation and fresh elections in states where elections took place. The BJP defended the Election Commission, emphasizing internal disagreements indicate a democratic process.

title: Your loan EMI has a Washington problem: How the Fed quietly influences RBI decisions
content: The US Federal Reserve’s quarter-percentage-point rate hike has added to the challenges facing the RBI ahead of its monetary policy review in October.

title: Another Trump-Putin meeting soon? US invites Russian Prez to G20 summit in Dec
content: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has confirmed that President Vladimir Putin has been invited to the upcoming G20 summit in December. Rubio emphasized that direct engagement between President Trump and world leaders could address important issues. There have been discussions on limited ceasefires in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war, with proposals from various countries. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed readiness for negotiations regarding maritime security in the Black Sea.

title: 'Bihar, Maha, Delhi, Haryana & Bengal': Oppn seeks repolls after EC 'dissent' report
content: Tejashwi Yadav has accused the Election Commission of being under BJP's influence to achieve electoral victories across various states. He also expressed his worries regarding the modifications to the voting records' retention period. Additionally, DMK chief MK Stalin has joined the call for the ousting of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, citing election discrepancies, while former West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee condemned the Commission’s management of voting lists.

title: UP RERA clears 12 projects worth Rs 1,664 crore across six districts
content: Uttar Pradesh's real estate sector is set to expand with the approval of 12 new projects. These projects will involve a total investment of Rs 1,663.85 crore across six districts. Lucknow will receive the largest share with four projects totaling 1,972 units. Ghaziabad and Hapur follow with several residential projects also approved. Authorities emphasize compliance with regulations and timely project completion to protect homebuyers' interests.

title: Asian Games medal tally: Where does India rank after Mirabai Chanu's silver?
content: Mirabai Chanu finally won her maiden Asian Games medal after finishing second in the women’s 49kg weightlifting event. The Olympic silver medallist lifted a total of 198kg (87kg in Snatch and 111kg in Clean & Jerk) to win silver. The medal ended India’s 28-year wait for a weightlifting medal at the Asian Games. Karnam Malleswari was the last Indian weightlifter to win an Asiad medal, taking silver in 1998.

title: Who is Matt Lawrence? Former FA Cup finalist captain survived two fentanyl overdoses
content: Matt Lawrence, a former professional footballer, faced two near-fatal drug overdoses in March 2021 due to fentanyl-laced cocaine. After his first overdose, responders revived him using Narcan, but he relapsed shortly after. He struggled with addiction and feelings of depression and regret following his overdose experiences. In August 2025, he committed to sobriety after his girlfriend intervened. Lawrence now focuses on family, work, and writing his autobiography.

title: NFL Trade Rumor: Commanders linked to $4M Browns QB amid Jayden Daniels injury
content: Shedeur Sanders is not playing. Deshaun Watson is playing for the Cleveland Browns. Washington Commanders lost Jayden Daniels after two games. The Commanders need a quarterback. Who better than Shedeur Sanders? He could shine alongside Daniels. Mariota could help as veteran. Stefon Diggs could be a reliable pass catcher for Sanders.

title: Gadkari urges sugar mills to make CBG; says Rs 22 lakh crore goes for fuel imports
content: Gadkari has called on sugar mills to expand into value-added by-products, particularly compressed bio-gas (CBG), ethanol, bio-manure and sustainable aviation fuel.

title: 'We were really looking forward to Japan': Teary-eyed Manu Bhaker remembers Rana
content: As Manu Bhaker walked into the mixed zone after the final, it was evident she was struggling to hold back her emotions. She managed to do so until the conversation turned to Rana, who passed away in June. Rana, one of the most decorated shooters in Asian Games history with eight medals, including four gold across three editions, had missed the Hangzhou Games as he was not part of the Indian contingent.

title: Meet Indian-origin CTOs leading OpenAI and Anthropic without IIT degrees
content: Michael Young's concept of meritocracy raises questions in India's engineering education system regarding the necessity of IIT degrees. Indian technologists Vijaye Raji and Rahul Patil have achieved prominent roles without attending IITs. Both engineers climbed the ranks in major tech firms before leading significant AI teams. Their success illustrates that merit in technology can come from diverse educational backgrounds.

title: 'Deliberations sign of pure democracy': BJP reacts to EC 'SIR split' row, targets Cong
content: BJP MP Sambit Patra defended the Election Commission's internal discussions as a sign of democracy. He accused opposition parties, particularly Congress, of undermining constitutional institutions due to electoral defeats. Patra highlighted that criticism of the Election Commission indicates a broader campaign against democratic bodies. He emphasized that the opposition's attacks are inappropriate and calls into question their respect for established institutions.

title: Travis Kelce’s $200M Six Flags investment hit as net loss tops $202M
content: Travis Kelce, the Kansas City Chiefs’ tight end's investment in Six Flags is headed for a loss as the company fails to do well.

title: Patrick Mahomes tops Josh Allen in Week 2 yards, but Nick Wright backs Allen
content: Nick Wright favors Josh Allen over Patrick Mahomes. Even though Mahomes led Week 2 in passing yards. Several analysts favor Allen for NFL MVP. He recorded nine touchdowns in the first two games of the season. Mahomes is favored for NFL MVP at the No. 2 spot, just behind Allen. Their comparison has lasted for ages.

title: Motivational quote of the day by Simon Cowell
content: Simon Cowell champions the idea that failure is a pivotal stepping stone on the road to achievement. He believes that facing failure grants clarity, providing opportunities for personal growth and insight. Embracing failure instead of dreading it empowers individuals to take bold risks while pursuing their dreams. Additionally, one's worth isn't defined by failure; the crucial lessons learned are far more significant than fleeting successes.

title: Who holds the leverage? Five cards Trump and Xi bring to the table
content: The anticipated meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping on September 24 serves as a platform to confront escalating tensions. Each leader arrives with their own strategic advantages in the realms of trade and technology, potentially shaping the discussions ahead. The intricate matters concerning Taiwan and rare earth supply chains will add layers of complexity to the talks.

title: 'MBS will not forget': Ex-US official warns Trump's Houthi stance has irked Saudis
content: Saudi Arabia has asked the US to carry out repeated air strikes against the Houthis, according to a person familiar with the discussions. Washington has so far declined, leaving Riyadh to confront an expanding threat largely on its own. The hesitation is particularly significant for Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, who has spent years relying on the US as Saudi Arabia’s main security partner.

title: F-35, Rafale, Tejas in one battlespace: Tarang Shakti brings the world's air power to India
content: The Indian Air Force is hosting the second edition of Tarang Shakti from September 26 to October 11. Nearly 40 air forces from various countries, including the United States and France, are participating in this exercise. This initiative aims to enhance military interoperability and share operational best practices among global air forces. The presence of advanced aircraft like the F-35 highlights the significance of this training.

title: Vijayendra seeks ₹5 lakh farm loan waiver for drought-hit farmers in Karnataka

title: Germany ready to sign ‘forward leaning’ deal with India for submarines: German Ambassador to India

content: The party rejects Opposition’s charge against SIR process, says Supreme Court had upheld its legal validity multiple times

content: According to Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL) officials, the man was noticed on the tracks by platform security guards, who alerted the station authorities.

title: No unfit drinking water samples, says SWR after quality checks
content: SWR tested samples for residual chlorine, bacteriological parameters and chemical parameters to ensure that water supplied to passengers and railway staff is safe for consumption, according to a release.

title: Nara Lokesh calls for mission-mode mental health support for A.P. students
content: Education Minister directs officials to expand mental health awareness, yoga training and institutional support; sets 90% results target for Class 10 and Intermediate exams

title: Railway Board sanction clears key hurdle for Bengaluru Metro Pink Line elevated section
content: The Pink Line, also known as the Kalena Agrahara–Nagawara corridor, spans 21.3 km, comprising around 7.5 km of elevated track and 13.8 km underground.

content: Once among the most powerful figures in the entertainment industry, Harvey Weinstein was an Oscar-winning producer. But his downfall came quickly after sexual assault allegations in 2017 set off the #MeToo movement.

content: Ganori Yadav is an accused in the 2003 murder of two brothers in Jamui's Pratappur village. He had been on the run for the past two decades.

title: 'Unwarranted': India rejects OIC's Kashmir references, takes shot at Pakistan
content: the ministry of external affairs said the entire Union territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh are an “integral and inalienable part of India” . the response came after a ministerial meeting of the OIC Contact Group . deputy prime minister and foreign minister Mohammad Ishaq Dar urged member states to maintain a “unified position” on jammu .

title: Jaishankar meets Rubio: India flags Russia sanctions, US waves friendship
content: s Jaishankar and Rubio met on the sidelines of the u.s. general assembly on friday . they raised a widening rift over the newly enacted Russia sanctions legislation . the difference in their post-meeting social media messaging was striking .

title: Israeli soldier accused of Gaza war crimes leaves India after complaint: Report
content: the soldier, whose identity has not been made public, left India in mid-September . it remains unclear whether the complaint influenced his departure or whether he left after completing his holiday . the move comes amid renewed calls for countries to uphold international law .

title: Pakistan’s hidden health crisis: Children contract HIV after routine hospital care
content: families allege their children contracted the virus while receiving medical care . the children were reportedly being treated for ordinary illnesses or undergoing routine procedures when, weeks or months later, they were found to be HIV positive . their families say they had no other known explanation for how the children could have contracted it .

title: 'Grateful for the journey': Billy Root retires from professional cricket at 34
content: Billy Root announces his retirement from professional cricket at the age of 34 . he is one of three Glamorgan batters whose playing careers will end this week . root played only two county championship matches and captaining the second XI .

title: Validity of CEC appointment law: SC split over Constitution Bench referral
content: the selection panel comprises the prime minister, a union cabinet minister and the leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha . the centre's argument against the collegium system for appointing judges is a myth . justice dipankar Datta said there was no need to refer the case to the constitution bench .

title: 'Judiciary reduced to playing second fiddle to govt’: SC slams collegium critics
content: justice Dipankar Dutta says the judiciary plays a "second fiddle" to the government . the judge rejects the government's argument that drew parallel between absence of an "outsider" in the collegium system of judicial appointments and the CJI's removal .

title: Disgraced Hollywood producer Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years for sexual assault
content: Harvey Weinstein, 74, was convicted of first-degree criminal sex act for sexually assaulting a former television production assistant . the victim addressed the court before sentencing, saying the assault had permanently affected her sense of safety . Weinstein was sentenced to 15 years in prison on friday for sexual assault .

title: China warns US not to cross 4 'red lines' as Xi heads to US for talks with Trump
content: Xie Feng highlighted Taiwan, democracy and human rights, China’s development path and political system as issues that cannot be challenged . he also called on the US to stop using issues such as national security, economic imbalances and forced labour as reasons to constrain China .

title: Oklahoma man says county plans to auction land strip inches from his home
content: a 40-foot strip of land just inches from his front door technically belongs to the county . local authorities plan to put the disputed piece of land up for auction, with bidding set to start at $29,000 . the dispute centers on a long-standing boundary mistake that went unnoticed for more than three decades .

title: 'UP ke ladke' in for political 'brawl'? SP, Cong spar over who can beat BJP in 2027
content: the "UP ke ladke" bonhomie is beginning to look less like a united front . Congress and Samajwadi Party leaders trading jabs over who can take on the BJP in 2027 . Iqra Hasan set off the latest bout of sparring by saying Congress "can't achieve much on its own"

title: 'Terrorist' or 'victims of terrorism'? Iran's Pezeshkian takes Trump head-on at UNGA
content: Pezeshkian hit back at the president's labelling of the Islamic Republic as "terrorist" he also held up photographs of an Iranian school and sports complex . the president also spoke about the killing of Iran's longest-serving supreme leader, Ayatollah .

title: Israel kills Hamas finance chief in Gaza strike, Netanyahu says ‘won’t stop’ until group no longer exists
content: israel says its military killed Muhammad Abu Alwan in a strike in Khan Younis in southern Gaza . prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu and defence minister Israel Katz confirmed the killing . they praised the Israel Defense Forces and Shin Bet for what they described as a 'precise operation' targeting Hamas .

title: California removed 44,000 trout; frogs in restored lakes rose from 190 to 18,800
content: in 2001, staff at Sequoia and Kings Canyon National Parks began removing non-native trout from selected lakes and streams . by 2011, nearly 44,000 trout had been removed from 19 lakes . surveys in three restoration lakes recorded an increase from nearly 190 frogs and tadpoles to more than 18,800 .

title: Can Pakistan afford to be the Muslim world's 'security guard'?
content: the bigger the question is how much can its military and economy carry? the country is trying to project strategic strength while simultaneously operating under a $7 billon international Monetary Fund programme . it's latest federal budget increased defence spending sharply while cutting federal development allocation .
